title: Journal Articles
text: We aim to keep a (moderately) current list of the research on the use of AI in Medical Education. Any omissions are accidental; please email Chris Runyon at CRunyon@nbme.org with any manuscripts that should be added to the list.

title: About
text:
This site was started to disseminate information relevant to the use of artificial intelligence in medical education, collecting manuscripts, talks, training / workshop series, etc.
The site is currently maintained by the AI in Med Ed special interest group that is a part of the Directors of Clinical Skills Education.
